claim_boundary: DIRAC-012 is the highest passed research gate. From the same two-field action, Lean derives the prepared-vacuum quadratic mass-plus-C19 channel, inserts the continuum four-component Hamiltonian into the actual centered recurrence, and bounds the normalized equation residual by explicit finite-timestep and fourth-order spatial terms. This is a controlled linearized low-momentum continuum theorem, not exact finite-lattice evolution. Density/current, nonlinear live-chi evolution, physical spin, and electron identity remain open.
